description: Prepare a bid strategy for one campaign with its target CPA or ROAS. target_cpa in whole account-currency units; the preview shows what the platform receives. Changes nothing: returns a preview_id (15 min, one use) for execute_prepared_change.

bid_strategy.description: The bid strategy to switch to.

campaign_id.description: ADS Beast id from list_campaigns, not the platform's.

target_cpa.description: Target cost per conversion in the ad account's currency, whole units. For target_cpa only.

target_roas.description: Target ROAS as a ratio, for example 4.0 for 400%. For target_roas only.

name: prepare_campaign_bid_strategy_change
